This '''species''' was a bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their [[Color|green]] skin, as well as a fin-like growth on top of their head and four pointed barbs extending from their face.<ref name="Mando9" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate}}</ref> a member of this species was present at [[Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk]] when [[Gor Koresh|Koresh]] attempted to take [[Din Djarin]]'s [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin's armor|armor]].<ref name="Mando9" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Catfish-Mando2Gallery.jpg|right|200px|thumb|This species' makeup and prosthetic application on the set of ''Chapter 9: The Marshal''.]]
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 9: The Marshal|first episode]] of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Jon Favreau]].<ref name="Mando9" /> This species was referred to by the nickname "Catfish" on set.<ref name="Gallery">{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Mandalorian: Making of Season Two|Making of Season Two}}</ref>
